## Activity

During October 2019, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 377 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below. The activity record is presented as a monthly summary for the site.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 16 were ungradable. The reported ungradable rate was 4.2. This result identifies the proportion of recorded captures that could not be graded and should be considered alongside the total capture activity for October 2019.

## Grading

Grading identified 49 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This is the reported midpoint for the interval between the capture being made and the grading outcome being recorded.

Taken together, the results show the volume of activity at Harbour Eye Clinic, the number of captures that were ungradable, and the number of referable results identified through grading. These measures are recorded for routine site monitoring and provide a concise summary of the service activity reported for October 2019.
